questions.question: How far should the three-line condense reach?

options.label: PR text + posting.md (Recommended)
options.description: Condense everything this PR adds, and also the older parts of posting.md (verify paragraph, forbidden instruments, --paginate note, closing rule). That file has the most slack, so the PR's net raise could come close to zero.

options.label: Only what the PR adds
options.description: Condense only the lines this PR adds or changes in posting.md, rvw-pr SKILL.md, ship SKILL.md and CLAUDE-REFERENCE.md. Older text stays as it is. The raise shrinks but stays positive.

options.label: Net zero
options.description: Same as the first option, but keep cutting until the total is at or below master's 301224, so the PR needs no raise at all. That may cost older rationale in posting.md.

In what order should the split and the four test runs happen?

options.label: Split first, then test (Recommended)
options.description: Move the gh route into posting-gh.md and push. Then run all four combinations against that head, so the tests cover the text that will merge. Runs from before the split would have to be repeated anyway.

options.label: Test first, then split
options.description: Run the four combinations on the current head, then split. You learn now whether the routes work, but the split changes the files a pass reads, so at least the local runs would need repeating.

options.label: Test only, no split
options.description: Keep both routes in posting.md and run the four combinations. Every posting pass keeps reading the gh route.

questions.question: Which runs do I do, and which do you do?

options.label: Local here, cloud by you (Recommended)
options.description: I run both local combinations from this session. You start two claude.ai/code sessions: one with /rvw-pr 1174 as its first prompt (no MCP yet), one after GitHub MCP has connected. I then check the comment counts and lines on the PR.

options.label: All four by you
options.description: You run every combination yourself, and I check the results on the PR afterwards.

How should the local no-MCP route be tested after the split?

options.label: You start a no-MCP session (Recommended)
options.description: In a second terminal on this branch, run `claude --strict-mcp-config` (it loads no MCP servers), then `/rvw-pr 1174`. That is the real condition: the pass cannot load the posting tool and has to read posting-gh.md. I check the count and lines afterwards.

options.label: Simulate it from here
options.description: I tell a reviewer pass to act as if the MCP posting tool did not load. Quick, but it is an injection: it shows the pass follows posting-gh.md, not that the routing triggers on its own.

options.label: Rely on the earlier runs
options.description: The gh route already posted on #1173 and #1174 before the split. Only the file it lives in changed. Cheapest, but the pointer from SKILL.md to posting-gh.md stays untested.

options.label: Fix both, then you test (Recommended)
options.description: I run /fix-pr on the two findings: recount before any retry on the gh route, and check ship_report's round counting (fix it or file it). I push, and your three runs then test the final text.

options.label: You test now, fix after
options.description: You start the local no-MCP run on the current head. The findings get fixed afterwards. A fix to posting-gh.md would mean repeating at least the gh-route runs.

options.label: Fix the retry only
options.description: Fix the retry bug in this PR and file the ship_report round counting as a backlog item. Then you test.

questions.question: On the gh route each FILE finding becomes its own one-comment review, so ship-report counts 1 + k rounds. REST can't put a FILE comment into the pass's review (just measured: HTTP 422, one pending review per user). How should this PR handle it?

options.label: State the bound, file an item (Recommended)
options.description: posting-gh.md says in one line that each FILE finding posts as its own review, which ship-report counts as a round. A new backlog item covers teaching ship_report.py and rfc-0015-findings.py, which both build the round grouping, to fold those into the pass's review. This PR stays small.

options.label: Fix the grouping here
options.description: In this PR, change both copies of the grouping: attach a review with an empty body whose comments are all file-level to the preceding review by the same author. Needs a test seen failing first, and widens this PR into the RFC-0015 classifier.

options.label: GraphQL locally, REST in the cloud
options.description: Where gh has GraphQL (locally), attach FILE threads to the pending review so it stays one review. The cloud keeps the separate reviews. Two recipes in posting-gh.md, against the condense you asked for.
